lecons.title: Road safety rules
lecons.summary: There are rules that guide road users to be safe on the road: look left and right before crossing, cross on the zebra crossing, do not make or receive calls when driving, respect road signs and traffic lights, walk on the pedestrian path.

explanations.body: Stop. Look left. Look right. If no car is coming, cross on the zebra.
The zebra crossing has white stripes, like a zebra.

lecons.title: Security and its agents
lecons.summary: Security is the state of being free from danger. It prevents crimes, creates a safe environment, promotes order and peace of mind, and keeps property safe. Police officers, soldiers, gendarmes, security guards and teachers are agents of peace and security.

explanations.body: When you are safe, nothing bad can happen to you.

lecons.title: Family income
lecons.summary: Family income is all the money a family receives during a particular period of time: a salary, the sale of articles like food crops, overtime labour, gifts from friends and well wishers, and rent of properties like houses.
